gloss: rising star; great hope; promising newcomer

definitions.gloss: rising star; the one everyone is counting on
definitions.explanation: A young or new person whom a team, company, or field expects great things from. Literally "star of expectation," and used most often in sports and entertainment reporting.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はチームの{期待|きたい}の{星|ほし}だ。
examples.english: She is the team's rising star.

examples.japanese: {若手|わかて}の{期待|きたい}の{星|ほし}として{注目|ちゅうもく}されている。
examples.english: He is drawing attention as a rising young star.

examples.japanese: {入社|にゅうしゃ}したころは{期待|きたい}の{星|ほし}と{呼|よ}ばれていたが、{本人|ほんにん}はその{言葉|ことば}を{重|おも}く{感|かん}じていたらしい。
examples.english: When he joined the company he was called the great hope, but apparently he found the phrase a heavy burden.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チームの{期待|きたい}の{星|ほし}: the team's rising star
- {期待|きたい}の{星|ほし}と{呼|よ}ばれる: to be called the great hope
- {日本|にほん}{球界|きゅうかい}の{期待|きたい}の{星|ほし}: the great hope of Japanese baseball

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ホープ: hope — the same idea borrowed from English, common in sports writing
- {有望株|ゆうぼうかぶ}: promising prospect — originally a stock-market term, slightly more businesslike
- {金|きん}の{卵|たまご}: golden egg — a promising young recruit, especially a new graduate
